status: Production API deployed; pairing/financial and client deadline contracts passed; strict 5-second latency target was NOT met for every sample

confirmed: The original global Edge route executed in sin1 while Supabase is in us-west-2.
The unpaired branch makes multiple serial rounds of HTTP queries, magnifying distance and upstream variability.
Database EXPLAIN ANALYZE measured the core function at 6.584ms unpaired and 202.269ms paired in the baseline fixtures; repeated HTTP round trips were much slower.
After regional execution, stable unpaired assembly dropped from approximately 1.6-2.5s to 0.3-0.4s.
The old mobile API, store and cover had independent five-second boundaries, discarding otherwise successful responses.
Next.js parsed preferredRegion=pdx1, but the first Node deployment actually deployed to iad1. An explicit single-function Vercel regions override was necessary and its final deployedTo was checked.
diagnosis.coldStartLimit: A baseline first-invocation request spent 2471ms inside the handler and 7271ms end-to-end. Its approximately 4800ms remainder includes platform startup/routing, serialization and network; it cannot all be attributed to cold-start using Server-Timing alone.
diagnosis.remainingTail: One final warm request took 5366ms: 3888ms in the handler, including a 3143ms core RPC round trip. Cold-start cannot explain this sample. RPC timings include transport, queue/lock wait and SQL; EXPLAIN samples do not prove the precise cause of that individual upstream delay.
